rules.finding: ^\+ button "(Name|Namespace|Ready|Up to date|Available|Status|Restarts|Roles|CPU|Memory|Version|Internal IP|External IP|Pod IP|Node|Type|Cluster IP|Ports|Revision|Chart|Chart version|Updated|Email|Team|Role|Age)"$
rules.why: A sortable column header holds a SortButton (frontend/src/components/SortButton.tsx), a button named as its column that gives the header a Tab stop; a click anywhere in the header still sorts.

The resource drawer is a modal dialog, named by its kind and title (role="dialog", aria-modal and aria-labelledby in frontend/src/components/ResourceDetailDrawer.tsx), so its tree starts with that dialog.
The Namespace drawer's own lines, the same in both builds, sit one level in under that dialog, and the comparison keeps each line's depth: each reads as gone and new.
